column1: # Rows db.evnan.ps.* (line RG, X-evalue-nan, 2026-11-28): psiblast `-evalue -nan` and `+inf` without -searchsp (Spouge's cutoff 0, blast_stat.c:5236-5269), a PSSM query with and without the composition-based redo (redo1: an HSP is reaped only when its e-value is greater than -evalue, blast_hits.c:1976-2003, and a NaN keeps no match, blast_kappa.c:3687), and PHI-BLAST's reap. tk.faa and ps4_tk_paja.asn.gz against paja, outfmt 6.

# Rows db.evnan.ps.knan.* (line RG, X-evalue-nan fix round 1, 2026-11-28): psiblast -in_pssm of a PSSM whose finalData kappa is NOT-A-NUMBER (tests/fixtures/pssm/ps7c_kappa_nan.asn) with the composition-based redo. The preliminary e-values are NaN; NCBI's best e-value of a list is NCBI's MIN from INT4_MAX (ncbi_std.h:112, blast_hits.c:1739-1749), a NaN, and the redo's early termination ends a match unless its best e-value is at most 5 times -evalue (redo_alignment.c:1561-1579), so a NaN ends it once the heap is filled, with an -evalue of 3e9 or 1e10 too (INT4_MAX, the best e-value LOSAT kept before, is below 5 times those).
